_comment: Shared HTML-input language cases, read by internal/htmlconv (rootAttrs) and extension/src/html.js (parseHtml). want is the language the converted page declares: <html> is asked first, then <body> (only the body's content is kept, so its declaration is lifted), each by lang and then xml:lang; a blank value counts as none. The desktop edition copies the tag as found, the extension normalizes it (lang.js normalizeLangTag), so every tag here is already in normal form. See docs/PARITY.md, HTML input language (audit finding E28).

cases.name: a blank html lang falls through to body
